title: The Graduation Curve
description: Walk the real bonding curve that prices a tokenized AI agent: 6,000 virtual VIRTUAL against 1B tokens on a constant product, spot ramping 64× to graduation at 42,000 VIRTUAL. The shaded area is VIRTUAL raised; toggle the halfway split to see the first 21,000 buy ~89% of supply.
controls: drag the slider to spend VIRTUAL along the curve
tap or drag the chart to place the buy marker
